description: Q70's template computes rank() over (partition by s_state) from a group by s_state, so every partition has one row, the rank is always 1, and the 'ranking <= 5' filter keeps all states (reasoning from the SQL, not run). The DataFrame implementations apply a global top-5 state filter following the spec prose. It is inert while the data holds one state (SQL returns 3 rows at every scale tested) but would diverge from the SQL once more states appear. The pandas half was reported by a reviewer and is unverified by me. Decide whether to follow the template (keep all states) or document the deviation, and make both families consistent with the SQL.
